name.zh: 原图兽耳桌宠（轻量渲染）

about.zh: 原图中的棕发兽耳角色；双马尾、红橙眼睛、黑白红服装、黑色手套与靴子、棕色大尾巴。造型与配色取自用户原图。
about.en: The brown-haired animal-eared character in the supplied reference image, with twin tails, orange-red eyes, black/white/red clothing, gloves, boots and a brown tail.

author: User reference / adapted for Coopanion

about.zh: 站起来(坐着、睡着时)
about.en: stands up (when sitting or asleep)

about.zh: 原地起跳
about.en: jumps on the spot

about.zh: 小小蹦一下
about.en: a small hop

about.zh: 左右张望
about.en: looks left and right

about.zh: 转向另一边
about.en: turns to face the other way

about.zh: 低头两下
about.en: dips the head twice

about.zh: 脸左右转
about.en: turns the face left and right

about.zh: 原地转一圈
about.en: spins around once on the spot

about.zh: 坐下
about.en: sits down

about.zh: 坐着打盹
about.en: dozes sitting down

about.zh: 头晕眼花几秒
about.en: dizzy for a few seconds

about.zh: 随便走一段
about.en: wanders a little way

about.zh: 跑到屏幕另一头
about.en: runs to the other end of the screen

about.zh: 举起靠近你的那只手挥一挥
about.en: raises the hand nearer to you and waves

about.zh: 闭眼,上身往前倾鞠一躬
about.en: closes the eyes and bows from the waist

about.zh: 缩着身子抖一会儿
about.en: huddles up and shivers for a while

about.zh: 开心地蹦起来,兽耳、尾巴、呆毛一起扑腾
about.en: bounces happily, ears, tail and ahoge all flapping

about.zh: 原地踩着节拍摇摆三秒,冒音符
about.en: sways to a beat on the spot for three seconds, music notes floating up
